title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

title: Senior Producer (Client Services & Project Coordination)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Producer (Client Services & Project Coordination) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Digital.ws

At Digital.ws, we help global brands solve complex communication challenges through creativity, technology, content, events, digital experiences, and production. We work with some of the most recognized companies in aviation, mobility, technology, and industry, delivering projects that range from social content and campaigns to websites, events, videos, branding, and interactive experiences.

We're looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, knows how to bring order to complexity, and can keep projects moving without losing sight of quality.


About the Role

As a Senior Producer, you will act as the central point connecting clients, internal teams, and external suppliers. This is a highly operational and strategic role. You will be responsible for organizing timelines, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, managing client communication, identifying risks, and ensuring projects are delivered on time and at a high standard. You should be comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a strong sense of urgency and ownership.


What You'll Do

  • Lead client communication and status meetings

  • Manage project scope, priorities, deadlines, and deliverables
  • Coordinate suppliers and production partners when required
  • Ensure quality control before deliveries
  • Keep internal teams aligned and informed throughout project execution


What We're Looking For:


Required

  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Previous experience in agencies, studios, production companies, or communication environments
  • Strong project management and client management skills
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong sense of urgency and accountability
  • Experience creating and maintaining schedules, project plans, and workflows
  • Outstanding communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Strong Plus

  • Experience with events and experiential marketing
  • Experience with graphic production and print materials
  • Experience with digital projects, websites, and interactive experiences
  • Experience with content production and social media campaigns
  • Familiarity with ClickUp or similar project management platforms
  • Understanding of creative, digital, video, and production workflows


What Success Looks Like

  • Projects delivered on time and with quality
  • Clients feeling informed, supported, and confident
  • Teams working efficiently with clear priorities
  • Risks identified early and solved proactively
  • Multiple projects moving forward simultaneously without losing control


Additional Information

  • Full-time position
  • 100% remote
  • Candidates must be based in the State of São Paulo
  • Competitive compensation based on experience

title: Business Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.

Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.

Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who are we?


We’re a true Kiwi tech success story, built from the ground up, with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.

We’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from within—with our very own team.

Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.

You can see more about our storyjourney here!


We create intuitive health and safety software that people want to use, giving businesses the visibility and data they need to prevent risks and build stronger, safer workplaces and safety cultures.


Safety isn’t just a department, it’s a culture that involves everyone, from frontline workers to the boardroom. ecoPortal makes safety simple, visible, and shared, with an intuitive interface that people actually want to use.

We help create stronger engagement, fewer incidents, and measurable improvements that drive both culture and performance.



The Role

An exciting opportunity is available at ecoPortal . We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our Project Management Office (PMO) Team, supporting the successful implementation of our Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance SaaS platform.


You’ll play a vital role in gathering, analysing, and finalising customer requirements, ensuring that each solution is tailored to deliver value while aligning with ecoPortal’s product capabilities and delivery standards.


As a Business Analyst , you’ll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Implementation Specialists , and customer stakeholders to design fit-for-purpose solutions—ranging from minimal changes to standard templates through to complex, bespoke configurations. You'll need strong communication, analytical, and documentation skills, and an ability to work across technical and business teams to ensure clarity, alignment, and successful delivery.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead customer workshops and meetings to capture, validate, and finalise business requirements in line with scope.
  • Translate customer needs into clear, technically aligned documentation using tools such as process flows, user stories, and functional specifications.
  • Support the design of both standard and custom solutions that align with ecoPortal platform capabilities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Project Managers, Implementation Specialists) to ensure smooth solution delivery.
  • Proactively identify and flag risks or misalignments early, recommending alternative solutions where appropriate.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by validating builds against requirements and assisting with defect triage.
  • Contribute to a smooth customer transition from implementation to business-as-usual (BAU) through handover documentation.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of ecoPortal’s platform functionality to provide practical, value-driven guidance.
  • Assist with continuous improvement initiatives, helping to refine our BA tools, templates, and methodologies.


We’re Looking for Someone Who…

  • Has 2+ years of Business Analyst experience , ideally within SaaS or software implementation environments.
  • Demonstrates strong requirement gathering, analysis, and solution design capabilities.
  • Can confidently facilitate workshops and work directly with customers and internal teams to define the “what” and the “why.”
  • Is proficient in documentation practices , including process mapping, user stories, functional specs, and change logs.
  • Understands the value of collaboration and can work fluidly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Has exposure to project delivery methodologies such as Agile or Hybrid models.
  • Communicates clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing.
  • Is naturally curious and detail-oriented , with a drive to understand how things work and improve them.
  • Has experience or familiarity with Health, Safety, Risk, and Compliance (HSRC) systems – a bonus, but not required!
  • Holds relevant certifications in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP, CCBA ) or has equivalent experience – highly desirable.


Perks & Benefits:

37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.

End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.


❤️

Your day at NTT DATA

  • Compartilhar conhecimento com outros times;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos produtos e serviços;
  • Participar de definições de tecnologia junto a clientes internos e externos;
  • Ser ponto focal de demandas técnicas que necessitem de direcionamento;
  • Priorização de demandas urgentes;
  • Ter viés de inovação e novas soluções disponíveis no mercado.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Conhecimentos consolidados nas soluções da Datadog, incluindo experiencia hands-on na execução de PoVs/PoCs;
  • Conhecimentos avançados nas plataformas de APM (Application Performance Manager);
  • Conhecimentos avançados em ELK Stack;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Grafana;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Splunk Observability;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em plataformas de NPM (Network Performance Manager).

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects end to end
  • A magic skill to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, or R

Compensation range

  • Poland: PLN12,600 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Lithuania: €2,500 - €8,000 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location: Remote (South & Central America, US Working Hours)

Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


Role Overview

As a Senior Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: User Researcher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para User Researcher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: Senior User Researcher

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Contract


We’re looking for a driven and inspiring Senior User Researcher to join our global team, to help businesses shape their strategy and bring to life products that win people’s hearts. You will have a chance to work across diverse industries and product lifecycles, partnering with some of the world’s most recognisable brands.

Bringing an experimental yet rigorous mindset, you will define the unknowns, challenge assumptions, and collaborate with stakeholders at every level to disrupt markets with new products or transform existing experiences, through customer-driven evidence.


Responsibilities:

  • Own user research stream on the project: from spotting opportunities through planning, user recruitment and execution, to helping the team prioritise and embed insight into the product.
  • Set up and manage user research process throughout discovery and delivery of a project, ensuring it fits seamlessly within agile workflows.
  • Conduct various types of research, depending on the context: exploratory, assessment, evaluative, quantitative and qualitative.
  • Collaborate with the design and product team to action the insights and embed them into strategy, roadmap and solutions.
  • Participate in enhancing the practice with the wider user research team: contribute to guidelines, knowledge sharings, supporting people who do research.
  • Consult presale teams on user research approaches for potential new projects, if needed.


Required skills and experience:

  • Well-versed in core user research methods and able to execute them independently; this is the minimum expectation for the role before we look at advanced skills.
  • An experimental mindset combined with rigour: you are comfortable trying new tools and approaches, while knowing the true value of user research and guardrails.
  • Proven experience assessing and validating early product concepts with various methods, not only interviews.
  • Skilled in defining customer segmentation across various markets.
  • Experience with recruiting participants for research.
  • A star facilitator, known for leading workshops, design sprints, and co-creation sessions that spark creativity and build alignment.
  • Strong sense of ownership and the drive to move work forward without waiting to be asked. You thrive on minimal direction: we’ll support you, but we want you to be the one moving things forward.
  • Stellar communication: advising, negotiating, and effectively collaborating with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Able to connect the dots and create compelling, evidence-led narratives that impact the way stakeholders think, build empathy for customers and guide product decisions.
  • Strong at managing priorities and deadlines: ready to stay organised and adaptable when things get busy or change direction.
  • Well-versed in tools that streamline research: Maze, Dovetail or similar tools for synthesis, repositories, unmoderated testing etc.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in a standalone user research role.


Nice to have:

  • Experience in Healthcare and/or Banking
  • Data analytics experience
  • Design experience
  • Experience in pre-sale activities


What’s in it for you?

  • The projects are various, which gives you a lot of new experiences and challenges. We work with start-ups, scale-ups and enterprise clients across different industries.
  • Ability to experiment with new approaches in product that incorporate AI tools, where it is appropriate
  • Work on projects for big global brands
  • Exposure to different geographies
  • Support and close collaboration with a cross-discipline team of Design, Product, BA and technical practitioners
  • Competitive salary depending on your skills and experience.
  • Constant development of your skills with the help of a knowledgeable product community: knowledge-sharing events and mentorship practices.
  • Regular support of your research leader and mentor.

  • Experiência com implementação, onboarding, customer success, gestão de projetos ou áreas relacionadas

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location: Remote (South & Central America, US Working Hours)

Department: Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


Role Overview

As a Senior Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization, indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills, able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Back End Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Back End Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Backend Engineer (Go)


Competitive Salary + Benefits

Full-Time


We're partnering with an established technology company operating at the intersection of content, data, and financial information services.

They're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling API-driven products that power data distribution, licensing, and content delivery at scale.

This is an opportunity to join a highly technical team, influence product direction, and work on systems that serve large volumes of real-time and historical data.


The Opportunity

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll take ownership of designing, building, and scaling backend services that underpin critical API products.

You'll work closely with product, engineering, and leadership teams to shape technical strategy, architect scalable systems, and deliver high-quality software that directly impacts customers.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, has strong architectural instincts, and wants to contribute beyond just writing code.


What You'll Be Doing

✅ Building and scaling API-first products and backend platforms

✅ Designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance distributed systems

✅ Taking ownership of the full software development lifecycle

✅ Working closely with stakeholders to define requirements and product enhancements

✅ Contributing to architecture decisions and long-term technical strategy

✅ Improving development processes, tooling, and engineering best practices

✅ Participating in technical planning and cross-functional collaboration

✅ Mentoring junior engineers and helping grow the engineering team

✅ Supporting recruitment and technical hiring initiatives

What We're Looking For


Essential Experience

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Go (Golang)
  • Experience building and maintaining large-scale backend applications
  • Strong understanding of software design principles and design patterns
  • Experience designing and consuming APIs
  • Kubernetes and containerized application experience
  • Experience working within Agile development environments
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


You'll Thrive Here If You

✔ Enjoy building products used by thousands of customers

✔ Like solving challenging technical and architectural problems

✔ Are curious about new technologies and engineering best practices

✔ Want to influence both product and technical direction

✔ Have an interest in financial markets, media, content, or data-driven products

✔ Love creating software that customers genuinely value


Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Equivalent practical experience is equally valued—we're just as interested in exceptional engineers who have built great software and can demonstrate their impact.

Interested? Apply directly or reach out for a confidential conversation to learn more about the opportunity.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: 12 Month Contract

Location: Brazil, Fully Remote

Rate: $1,659 BRL R$/month - $3,316 BRL R$/month




JOB DESCRIPTION

Their day to day includes accurately labeling machine learning textual data to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines. This person must be able to read, write and summarize at a high volume and high accuracy.


Day to Day Responsibilities

Accurately label machine learning data through various methods to refine AI models. This will primarily involve annotating large volumes of textual data according to predefined guidelines.

Collaborate with team members to identify improvements to the labelling interface or labelling processes in order to drive efficiency and high-quality.

Complete assignments by deadlines while meeting team expectations and goals.


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE


Bachelor’s Degree. Open major, provided the academic background demonstrates high-level critical thinking, synthesis, and reading comprehension (e.g., Translation, Law, Psychology, Marketing, or Humanities).

C1 (Advanced) or C2 (Mastery) English fluency.

3-4 months of data annotation or LLM evaluation experience (Textual data annotation preferred)

Proficiency in reading comprehension and possessive of strong writing skills, with the ability to understand and interpret complex and diverse texts.

Ability to work independently, follow instructions, manage time effectively, and meet deadlines in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Ability to manage ambiguity, uncertainty, and changing priorities with limited resources.

Ability to accept and integrate continuous feedback while remaining professional.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate within a multi-disciplinary team.

Quick learner and self-starter with strong problem-solving skills.


NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Experience w RLHF (Reinforcement Learning Human Feedback)

Multiple Language proficiency

Experience with multi modal data annotation (Text, Image, Video)

QA or QC experience

title: Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / React)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / React) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Remote Contract Developer at Honor Tech LLC

Honor Tech LLC is a growing company specializing in custom software development for public sector initiatives and private companies alike. We have recently acquired new contracts that require talented developers to join our team quickly. 

Why Join Honor Tech?

This remote-friendly contract position offers significant flexibility and an opportunity to contribute to impactful projects with a dedicated, positive team. As a young, agile company, we are focused on growth, and as we expand, there may be opportunities to move top performers into salaried roles and/or leadership positions.

About You

We’re looking for a self-sufficient, experienced full-stack software developer who can hit the ground running without training beyond their existing skills. You should be comfortable working independently while also collaborating with teammates as needed. You’re adaptable, quick to solve problems, and thrive in a fast-paced, Agile/Scrum environment. While we encourage continued learning, this position is not a training role: we need someone who can contribute immediately and deliver results from day one. Times are changing and Honor Tech is aware and immersed in this, so we also expect that you will come to the table with a solid understanding of how to use the latest AI tooling to enhance your development and have embraced (as opposed to resisted) this massive shift in the tech industry. A combination of the right experience and the right adaptation of new skills will make the perfect candidate for this role.

Responsibilities
  • Independently design, develop, and maintain web applications using ReactJS, TypeScript, and .NET (C#).
  • Build and integrate modern APIs with validation, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  • Design and optimize database schemas and SQL queries for performance and scalability in SQL Server, MariaDB, and MySQL.
  • Configure and manage AWS infrastructure (EC2, IAM, VPNs, security groups) and set up monitoring tools like CloudWatch.
  • Integrate Mail Servers (SMTP) and build scalable email solutions with tracking and retry capabilities.
  • Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and authentication systems to secure APIs and web applications.
  • Ensure scalability and fault tolerance with multi-threading, parallel programming, and queuing systems.
  • Perform unit testing, end-to-end testing, and stress testing to validate system performance and reliability.
  • Write clear, customer-facing technical documentation and contribute to development standards and best practices.
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools where appropriate, validating all AI-generated code for correctness and performance.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development.
  • Proficiency in ReactJS and TypeScript for frontend development.
  • Proficiency in .NET (C#) for backend API and service development.
  • Strong SQL skills and database experience with SQL Server, MariaDB, or MySQL.
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure, including EC2, IAM roles, security groups, and CloudWatch monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with Mail Servers and SMTP Integration for email workflows and tracking.
  • Expertise in API Development and Integration, including RESTful and SOAP protocols, rate-limiting, and error handling.
  • Experience implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and authentication mechanisms.
  • Ability to build scalable, fault-tolerant systems for high-volume transactions.
  • Proven ability to work independently and start contributing immediately without extensive onboarding or training.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English. You must be able to comfortably participate in live, spontaneous technical discussions and write clear documentation independently, without the use of translation software or real-time translation tools.  
Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Experience with Amplify and Cognito for authentication and user management.
  • Experience with Microsoft Identity.
  • Familiarity with Twilio and SendGrid integrations.
  • Knowledge of DevExpress and for UI components.
  • Experience with Dapper and EFCore for database optimization.
  • Skills in parallel programming, dependency injection, and scalability-focused development.
  • Prior use of AI-assisted coding tools with proper validation techniques.

Job Type: Full-time Contract (40 hours/week)

Pay: Competitive Hourly Rate (TBD based on experience, paid in USD)

Compensation & Compliance: Independent Contractor Agreement. Paid via W-9 (US-based) or W-8BEN/International Contractor terms (Non-US).

Schedule: Flexible 8-hour days, 5 days per week. Requires core hours overlap for standing/recurring team meetings.

Work Location: Remote


If you’re ready to jump in and deliver results immediately as part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team, we’d love to hear from you! Contact us today to learn more about how you can contribute to Honor Tech LLC's mission.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About U S

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

•Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collection issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review the new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant


Requirements

4+ years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP

Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Accounting or Finance degree

Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST


Benefits

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.


Our Core Values:

Loyalty

Integrity

Strong Work Ethic

Forward Thinking - Grow The Mindset

Team Player / Caring / Selfless

Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh

Freedom & Accountability

title: Senior Frontend (Angular) Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Frontend (Angular) Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

XILO , a fast-growing Vertical AI company recently backed by a Series A financing round, is seeking a highly experienced and driven Senior Frontend Engineer to elevate our Angular codebase, improve modularity, and mentor junior engineers in writing clean, maintainable front-end code.

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

You’ll be at the heart of shaping the user experience for thousands of insurance professionals, wrapping powerful AI-driven automation in an intuitive, efficient, and beautiful interface.

This isn’t just another frontend job. Insurance agents spend hours wrestling with outdated, clunky systems -your work will change that. We’ve seen first-hand how much frustration our automation removes, and with your help, we’ll take it even further – creating tools that don’t just work, but feel seamless, fast, and a joy to use.

We’re building with modern frontend technologies, including Angular , to ensure high performance, efficiency, and scalability. If you’re an expert in Angular’s latest features , you’ll have a unique opportunity to push the boundaries of frontend performance and UX in a data-heavy, AI-powered platform.


You’ll have the opportunity to work on:

  • Modern UI & UX for AI-Driven Automation – Designing interfaces that make complex workflows feel effortless
  • Agent-Focused Productivity Tools – Crafting dashboards and interactive tools that help agencies work faster and smarter
  • Seamless Platform Experience – Maintaining and evolving our design system to ensure a consistent, polished experience across the platform
  • AI-Powered Browser Extensions – Building extensions that bring AI Agents to life beyond APIs, automating workflows directly on carrier portals and legacy systems that don’t support direct integrations
  • Advanced PDF Processing & Rendering – Creating dynamic, interactive document management tools that handle complex insurance forms and policies seamlessly


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of frontend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Extensive experience with Angular (19+), including migrating projects to newer versions.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos to manage and scale frontend applications efficiently.
  • Optimizing build processes to improve application performance and loading times.
  • Proficient in REST API integration, including security and authentication strategies.
  • Bonus: Hands-on experience developing browser extensions, extending automation beyond traditional web applications.
  • Bonus: Experience with WebSockets for real-time data updates and event-driven UI interactions.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with backend technologies like Node.js and Nest.js.


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.


Why join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior (Node e React)
description:

Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior atuando de forma com Node e React, que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Tecnologia e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações backend e frontend utilizando Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript e React
  • Participar da definição e evolução da arquitetura, propondo soluções escaláveis, performáticas e sustentáveis;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações web e mobile;
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços de nuvem, bancos de dados e iniciativas de DevOps, garantindo escalabilidade e confiabilidade;
  • Participar de code reviews e promover boas práticas, qualidade e consistência do código;
  • Realizar análises e viabilidades técnicas, avaliando impactos, complexidade, aderência arquitetural e estratégias de implementação para apoiar decisões e priorizações do negócio;
  • Explorar, testar e propor o uso de soluções e ferramentas baseadas em IA que contribuam para ganho de produtividade, melhoria da experiência do usuário e evolução dos produtos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times multidisciplinares para resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções alinhadas ao negócio.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com desenvolvimento backend e frontend utilizando Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript e React;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado utilizando Redux e/ou Zustand;
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem como Firebase, AWS, GCloud ou similares;
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, como Postgres e MongoDB;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados e práticas de qualidade de software;
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de software, APIs, padrões de desenvolvimento e boas práticas (Clean Code/Clean Architecture);
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps, automação e pipelines CI/CD;
  • Vivência com arquitetura orientada a serviços e/ou ambientes serverless;
  • Experiência com Git e metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Interesse, familiaridade ou experiência no uso de recursos de Inteligência Artificial aplicados ao desenvolvimento, automação e produtividade, utilizando ferramentas como Cursor, Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT ou similares, além de iniciativas de aprendizado contínuo no tema;
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas complexos e construir soluções escaláveis.


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em construção, evolução e definição de arquitetura técnica;
  • Experiência ou potencial para atuar como referência técnica ou evoluir para uma posição de Tech Lead, apoiando decisões técnicas, mentoria e desenvolvimento do time;
  • Experiência com tecnologias de desenvolvimento mobile ou híbrido, como React Native, Capacitor, Cordova ou Ionic;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup e crescimento acelerado.


O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

title: Engagement Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engagement Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Engagement Manager


Drive customer success. Lead digital transformation. Deliver meaningful outcomes.

At Radsoft, we help organizations accelerate their digital transformation through innovative software solutions, low-code platforms, and modern engineering practices.


With over two decades of experience delivering business-critical solutions across multiple industries, we combine deep technical expertise with a people-first culture that empowers teams to innovate, collaborate, and create real business impact.


We're looking for an Engagement Manager who thrives at the intersection of business, technology, and customer success. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working directly with clients, understanding business challenges, translating requirements into actionable solutions, and leading multidisciplinary teams to successful project delivery.


If you're passionate about building strong customer relationships, facilitating collaboration, and delivering value through Agile software development, we'd love to hear from you.


Your mission

As an Engagement Manager, you'll be responsible for driving successful project outcomes while serving as the primary bridge between customers and delivery teams.


You'll own stakeholder engagement, requirements management, backlog prioritization, Agile delivery processes, and overall project success.


What you'll do

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Act as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders and delivery teams.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, workshops, requirements gathering, and business process discussions.
  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable User Stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring priorities align with business objectives.
  • Lead Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across different locations and time zones.
  • Manage project scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, budgets, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Monitor project health and proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks.
  • Ensure alignment between customer goals, product vision, and delivery outcomes.
  • Support change management and guide clients through digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coach customers and project teams on Agile best practices and effective backlog management.


What we're looking for

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in software delivery, project management, product ownership, business analysis, or customer engagement roles.
  • Proven experience working directly with customers and business stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience gathering requirements and writing User Stories independently.
  • Experience managing and prioritizing product backlogs.
  • Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
  • Experience delivering web or enterprise software solutions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and decision-making abilities.
  • Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written).

Nice to have

  • Experience delivering low-code projects, particularly with OutSystems.
  • Product Owner, Scrum Master, PMP, PMI-ACP, or Agile certifications.
  • Experience leading distributed or international teams.
  • Knowledge of software development processes and solution design.
  • Exposure to digital transformation programs and enterprise applications.


What success looks like in this role

  • Customers trust you as a strategic partner.
  • Teams have clear priorities and well-defined requirements.
  • Projects are delivered predictably and successfully.
  • Stakeholders remain aligned and informed.
  • Business value is continuously delivered through Agile practices.


What you'll find at Radsoft


Customer impact

Work directly with organizations undergoing digital transformation and help solve real business challenges.


International exposure

Collaborate with global teams and customers across multiple industries and markets.


Flexible work model

Enjoy a remote-first culture with autonomy and work-life balance.


Continuous development

Access training, mentoring, certifications, and career progression opportunities.


Collaborative culture

Join a company that values teamwork, ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement.


Benefits

  •  Fully remote work model
  •  Training and certification budget
  • Career development plan
  • International project exposure
  • People-first culture


Ready to make an impact?

If you're passionate about customer success, Agile delivery, business analysis, and digital transformation, we'd love to hear from you.


Join Radsoft and help organizations turn ideas into successful digital solutions.


Screening Questions

To help us understand your experience, please answer the following questions when applying:


  • Do you have 5+ years of experience in software delivery, project management, product ownership, or business analysis?
  • Have you worked in Agile/Scrum software delivery environments?
  • Have you personally written User Stories, managed requirements, and maintained a product backlog?
  • Have you managed customers or business stakeholders directly throughout a project lifecycle?
  • Are you comfortable communicating professionally in English, both written and spoken?

title: Head of Growth
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Growth em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process and deliver tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

We’re free for brands and monetize on the agency side. Customers include Shopify, Coca-Cola, Columbia Records, Burt’s Bees, Roc Nation, Magic Spoon, Sony Music, and Estée Lauder, plus a long list of venture-backed and mid-market brands. We also operate Case Studied, a 40,000+ subscriber marketing newsletter that’s become one of the most-read publications in B2B marketing.


About the Role

This is an individual contributor role. It is not a management role. You will not be hiring, leading, or coaching a team. You will be running experiments, lots of them, across paid media, SEO, and product surfaces, and you will be doing the work yourself.


The title says Head of Growth, but the work is hands-on. You’ll be in the ads manager every day. You’ll be writing your own copy, generating your own creative, building your own landing page tests, and shipping your own programmatic SEO templates. If you want to spend your week in dashboards, spinning up tests, and arguing with the data, this is the right role. If you want to delegate any of that, it isn’t.


The right person treats growth as a lab. You have a testing instinct that’s borderline obsessive. You wake up wondering whether you can squeeze 15% more efficiency out of a LinkedIn audience. Whether a programmatic SEO template can be expanded to 5,000 more pages. Whether a free tool converts better as a calculator or a benchmark. You don’t wait for permission to test. You’d rather ship a rough experiment this week than wait three weeks for a clean one.


You’ll report directly to the CEO. You’ll set the growth roadmap, prioritize the test backlog, and allocate the budget. The work is yours to run.


What You’ll Do

Paid Media

• Run paid media yourself across LinkedIn, Google, and Meta. Daily optimization, audience and creative testing, budget shifts, the actual button-clicking. You are the person in the platform, not the person reviewing someone else’s screenshots.

• Design and run a structured testing program. We expect multiple live experiments at any given time across audiences, creative, landing pages, and bidding.

• Maintain clean test design. Isolated variables, defined sample sizes, written hypotheses, and post-mortems with real takeaways.

• Pilot new paid channels (Reddit, X, podcast sponsorships, partner ads) when signal suggests they’re worth a test.


Ad Creative

• Concept and produce ad creative yourself using AI tools. You should be the person making the creative, not the person briefing someone to make it.

• Brief external designers, UGC creators, and motion partners when production volume goes beyond what you can ship solo.

• Keep the creative pipeline healthy. Every underperforming slot gets refreshed quickly.

• Turn winning angles into testable variations across channels.


SEO and Programmatic SEO

• Own the SEO roadmap for vendry.io and Case Studied.

• Build programmatic SEO at scale. Page templates, structured data inputs, internal linking, sitemap architecture, and indexation strategy.

• Run scalable SEO experiments across page structure, content depth, intent matching, and CTAs.

• Coordinate with engineering on technical implementation and Core Web Vitals.


Product-Led Experiments

• Work with engineering to ship lead magnets, free tools, viral mechanics, and shareable assets.

• Identify the product surfaces where small changes move the funnel (onboarding, results pages, share flows) and design experiments against them.

• Treat product and marketing as one funnel. Close the loop between channel performance and on-site experience.


Measurement

• Build and maintain the growth dashboard yourself. Spend, MQLs, pipeline, CAC, payback, channel-level efficiency.

• Communicate weekly results in plain language. What worked, what didn’t, what’s next.

• Make budget decisions based on data, not recency or intuition.


Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years in growth, performance marketing, or demand generation as a hands-on operator.

• Demonstrated B2B experience is mandatory. This role will not work for someone whose track record is purely DTC or consumer. You need to understand B2B funnel dynamics: long sales cycles, MQL-to-pipeline conversion, account-level intent, and how creative and channel decisions ripple through a slow funnel.

• Direct, hands-on experience running LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and Meta at meaningful spend.

• AI-native creative production. You should be able to ship an ad concept yourself in a few hours using current tools (Midjourney, Runway, Claude or ChatGPT for copy, similar).

• Programmatic SEO experience. We want to see a project you shipped, not just familiarity with the concept.

• A genuine love for experimentation. This is the core requirement of the role. You should be the kind of person who runs personal experiments on the side, who reads test results for fun, who has strong opinions about test design and sample sizes. If you don’t actively enjoy this, the role won’t click.

• A real testing track record. Be ready to walk through experiments you designed, ran, and learned from in detail. Hypothesis, design, result, takeaway.

• Strong analytical instincts. Spreadsheets, dashboards, and attribution tools (GA4, HubSpot, Meta and LinkedIn reporting) should be second nature.

• Strong growth mindset and fast learning curve. The channels we win on a year from now may not be the ones we win on today. You should be wired to pick up new platforms quickly and be intellectually honest when a channel stops working.


Preferred

• Background in a B2B marketplace, agency, or SaaS company that grew primarily through paid acquisition.

• Familiarity with HubSpot, Monday.com, Make or n8n, and similar GTM tooling.

• Newsletter or media growth experience.

• Past product-led growth work alongside engineering.

• Ownership of a content or SEO program that produced meaningful inbound.


Not a fit if

• You want to manage people. There is no team here, and we’re not building one for this role.

• You’re used to setting strategy and handing it off. Strategy here is whatever you ship and ship next.

• You need a clean, slow testing environment. Vendry moves fast and tests cheap.


Why Join Vendry

This role is for someone who wants to operate, not manage. You’ll work directly with the CEO, set your own roadmap, run your own budget, and see the impact of your work in pipeline every week.


The marketing engine works already. Paid social drives MQLs. Case Studied reaches 40,000+ marketing decision-makers. We close deals with brand-name client logos every month. We need one person who can systematize what’s working and run experiments hard enough to find the next thing.


We’re a small, fast, collaborative team. We value quality work, sharp judgment, and direct communication.

Confira esta oportunidade para em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Own a category like it is your own business.


LifeSupplyUSA is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce retailers of household essentials in the US: air filters, HVAC filters, extension cords, and home goods. We sell across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, and Canada with a lean, high-performance remote team, and we are building a sharper, more scalable company with better dashboards, cleaner SOPs, and real ownership.


We are not looking for someone to monitor reports or update listings. We are looking for an operator who turns marketplace data into action and owns the result.


THE ROLE


You will own a defined block of our catalog (starting with extension cords, our largest category) like a P&L. You will know your category and your top competitors cold, watch your listings every day, and make the pricing, inventory, and advertising calls that protect rank and margin.


This is a judgment and ownership role. Not data entry. Not catalog cleanup. Not dashboard watching.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN


Category P&L: in-stock rate, contribution margin, TACOS, and category profit. You run it like an owner.

Daily monitoring of your top SKUs: competitor pricing, deals and lightning deals, stock positions, Buy Box, and listing health.

Pricing decisions within a clear rule set, including our low-stock governor (when a winner runs low, you decide whether to raise price or pull ad spend to protect rank instead of going out of stock).

In-stock discipline on core winners, working with forecasting and sourcing so proven sellers are never starved.

️ Listing quality: titles, images, A+ content, variations, and pack configurations.

♻️ Liquidation calls on end-of-life and slow-moving inventory.

Channel growth: extend your winners onto Walmart, Shopify, and Canada.

  • Publicação e distribuição de aplicativos nas lojas Apple App Store e Google Play ;

  • Testes automatizados;
  • Ferramentas e conceitos de UX/UI Design .


Informações adicionais

title: Backend Developer — SAP CAP + HANA Cloud
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Backend Developer — SAP CAP + HANA Cloud em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Make this the place where you grow!


Como NTT DATA Business Solutions, somos mais do que apenas uma empresa. Somos uma equipe de pessoas apaixonadas que impulsionam a inovação – desde consultoria e implementação até serviços gerenciados e muito mais. Com a SAP no nosso núcleo e um poderoso ecossistema de parceiros como Microsoft e ServiceNow, continuamos aprimorando soluções e tecnologias baseadas em IA para que funcionem para as empresas – e para suas pessoas,


Com operações em mais de 30 países e reunindo 18.500 especialistas representando mais de 90 países, permitimos que milhares de empresas se tornassem mais eficientes e eficazes nas últimas três décadas.


Fazemos parte da NTT DATA, líder de US$ 30+ bilhões em serviços empresariais e tecnológicos, IA e infraestrutura digital, atendendo 75% da Fortune Global 100. Co-inovamos soluções com clientes e parceiros globalmente para impacto empresarial e social. Como um dos principais empregadores globais, a NTT DATA conta com especialistas em mais de 70 países. A NTT DATA faz parte do Grupo NTT.


Conosco, você tem infinitas oportunidades para pensar grande, agir com ousadia e assumir a responsabilidade. Faça deste o lugar onde você pertence, aprende e constrói sua rede. Make this the place where you grow!


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Você irá construir a camada do lado do servidor de uma aplicação em nuvem na SAP BTP para um cliente global de bens de consumo: serviços CAP em Node.js, modelagem de dados na SAP HANA Cloud via HDI e autorização. Você irá trabalhar diariamente com um desenvolvedor frontend (UI5 / Fiori Elements), um revisor de código e um engenheiro de qualidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Construir serviços CAP: entidades CDS, projeções, visualizações, aspectos, ações e funções.
  • Implementar manipuladores CAP (srv.before / on / after) para lógica de negócios, ciclo de vida de rascunho e validação.
  • Aplicar anotações rigorosamente: @odata, @restrict, @requires, @assert, @readonly, @mandatory.
  • Usar entidades tipadas de @cds-models (sem strings brutas em CQL); importar apenas de @sap/cds.
  • Modelar e ajustar SAP HANA Cloud: contêineres HDI, visualizações de cálculo (quando necessário), planos de explicação, índices, particionamento.
  • Aplicar autorização: @restrict baseada em instância, escopos XSUAA, modelos de função, coleções de funções; isolamento multitenant quando aplicável.
  • Escrever testes de integração cds.test() e testes unitários Jest; cobrir o caminho infeliz; manter testes determinísticos.
  • Emitir logs estruturados via SAP Cloud Logging — nunca registrar segredos ou PII.
  • Implantar via MTA (mbt validate, mbt build, cf deploy); testar rapidamente o catálogo de serviços.
  • Negociar o contrato OData com o desenvolvedor frontend; comunicar mudanças disruptivas cedo.
  • Participar do SCRUM (planejamento, diário, revisão, retrospectiva, refinamento); estimar histórias; relatar bloqueios.



Habilidades Necessárias

  • CAP Node.js: @sap/cds, definições .cds, manipuladores, manipulação de rascunhos, ações/funções personalizadas, plugins, cds-typer.

  • Conhecimento em CRO, SEO, UX ou Performance Digital.
  • Experiência em agências, consultorias ou operações digitais.
  • Familiaridade com dashboards e indicadores de negócio.
  • Experiência na construção de roadmaps e planejamento evolutivo de projetos.


Se você se identifica com esse perfil, é apaixonado por inovação e ambientes dinâmicos, e quer contribuir com nosso time, queremos te conhecer!

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior / Especialista Databricks
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados Sênior / Especialista Databricks em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior/Especialista com sólida experiência na plataforma Databricks para liderar uma transformação estratégica na nossa fundação de dados.

Seu principal objetivo será extrair a inteligência de negócios hoje \"escondida\" em dashboards e regras DAX, centralizando-a em uma Camada Semântica Corporativa robusta e escalável. Essa estrutura será o alicerce para alimentar nossos Agentes de IA, Copilotos e LLMs , além de garantir governança, linhagem e qualidade de dados de ponta a ponta através do Unity Catalog .


Desafios e Responsabilidades (Frentes de Atuação)Frente 1: Camada Semântica Corporativa & IA Readiness

  • Engenharia Reversa em DAX: Analisar e mapear as regras de negócio e métricas atualmente implementadas em Power BI/DAX.
  • Construção do Repositório Semântico: Estruturar, padronizar e centralizar métricas, dimensões e KPIs corporativos no ecossistema Databricks.
  • Abastecimento de IA: Disponibilizar essa camada semântica e seus contextos de forma otimizada para consumo ágil por LLMs, mecanismos de busca semântica e agentes de IA.
  • Padronização: Definir padrões de arquitetura para a evolução contínua da camada semântica (ex: modelagem dimensional na camada Gold/Semantic).

Frente 2: Catálogo, Descoberta e Governança de Dados

  • Implementação via Unity Catalog: Estruturar o catálogo corporativo unificado para garantir uma experiência centralizada de descoberta de dados (tanto para perfis técnicos quanto de negócio).
  • Centralização do Conhecimento: Migrar e consolidar documentações técnicas e funcionais hoje dispersas (GitLab, Wikis, etc.) para dentro do catálogo de dados.
  • Linhagem e Qualidade: Mapear a linhagem de dados (data lineage) dos ativos críticos e desenhar estratégias/recomendações para monitoramento e qualidade de dados (ex: Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring, Delta Live Tables).

Frente 3: Colaboração e Mentoria

  • Transferência de Conhecimento: Atuar em sinergia com o time interno (Cliente), realizando a passagem de bastão completa das frentes implementadas, padrões definidos e boas práticas adotadas.


Requisitos Técnicos (O que buscamos)

  • Experiência Avançada em Databricks: Domínio da plataforma (Delta Lake, Spark/PySpark, Delta Live Tables e Databricks SQL).
  • Mestre em Unity Catalog: Experiência prática na estruturação de governança, controle de acessos (regras de segurança) e linhagem usando o Unity Catalog.
  • Experiência com Camadas Semânticas: Vivência prática na centralização de métricas de negócio (seja via views homologadas no Databricks, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube ou ferramentas correlatas).
  • Conhecimento em Power BI / DAX: Capacidade de ler, interpretar e traduzir fórmulas DAX complexas para SQL/PySpark.
  • Familiaridade com LLMs/GenAI: Entendimento de como LLMs consomem dados (estruturados e não estruturados), conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e metadados enriquecidos para IA.
  • Práticas de Engenharia de Software: Controle de versão (Git/GitLab), CI/CD aplicado a dados e documentação técnica clara.

Diferenciais (Pontos Extras)

  • Certificações oficiais Databricks (Data Engineer Professional ou Cloud Data Management / Governance).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de qualidade de dados (ex: Great Expectations, Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de transição de arquitetura Self-Service BI tradicional para Semantic Lakehouse.


Resultados Esperados (O seu legado)

  • Uma Camada Semântica robusta e pronta para servir de contexto a copilotos corporativos.
  • Catálogo Corporativo de Dados funcional, documentado e acessível para usuários técnicos e tomadores de decisão.
  • Redução drástica da dependência de dashboards como \"regras de negócio isoladas\".
  • Uma fundação de dados escalável e governada para as iniciativas de IA da companhia.
  • Time interno capacitado e autônomo para dar continuidade ao trabalho.
