Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

NÃO SE CANDIDATE CASO NÃO POSSUA EXPERIÊNCIA COM ENSINO DE INGLÊS CORPORATIVO. CANDIDATURAS FORA DO PERFIL SERÃO DESCARTADAS.

  • Experiência no ensino de língua inglesa para adultos;
  • Pontualidade, proatividade, colaboração, organização, boa comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal e trabalho em equipe.


Indispensável:

  • Experiência internacional em país de língua inglesa;
  • Formação superior nas áreas de Business;
  • Disponibilidade para turmas aos sábados pela manhã;

A contratação inicia-se no cargo de Professor Auxiliar, com um período de adaptação de aproximadamente 2 a 3 meses, durante o qual será avaliada a adequação do professor à metodologia da escola e aos padrões pedagógicos adotados.


Após esse período, havendo bom desempenho e alinhamento metodológico, o professor poderá ser efetivado como Professor Oficial. A partir da efetivação, o profissional passa a ter direito ao benefício de plano de saúde, além das demais condições previstas no plano de carreira.

Fourthwall gives creators the freedom to do what they do best: create. The company is the engine behind the scenes, helping creators -- YouTubers, streamers, podcasters, comedians, and anyone building an online audience -- turn their ideas into income. From merch to hot sauce to subscription memberships and more, Fourthwall makes building a business as fun and creative as the content itself. Fourthwall is a remote-friendly team with roots in Los Angeles and Poznan, and a culture that values autonomy, collaboration, and momentum

This is a high-trust role for someone who can create structure, manage priorities, drive follow-through, and keep complex operating workstreams moving. It sits at the intersection of operations, project management, leadership support, and systems thinking

You will help create structure around a fast-moving operations function as Fourthwall scales its supply chain, supplier network, product categories, and larger B2B partnerships. The SVP of Operations moves quickly and focuses on strategy, deals, and high-leverage decisions. Your role is to make sure the details, follow-ups, project plans, and operating cadence keep pace

The ideal candidate is highly organized, operationally fluent, discreet, and comfortable holding people accountable with maturity and tact. You do not need to have personally run a warehouse or supply chain organization, but you should understand enough about operations to know the language, spot gaps, ask good questions, and help keep complex workstreams on track

.What You'll D

  • oOwn the operating rhythm for the SVP of Operations, including priorities, follow-ups, action items, project trackers, meeting notes, and decision logs
  • .Keep multiple supply chain and business operations initiatives moving across internal teams, suppliers, partners, and stakeholders
  • .Help manage programs related to new suppliers, new product categories, operational workflows, and larger B2B partnerships
  • .Build and maintain clear trackers, workflows, status updates, and project plans so leadership has visibility into what is moving, stuck, or at risk
  • .Follow up with internal owners and external partners to make sure commitments, deadlines, and next steps do not fall through the cracks
  • .Prepare agendas, summaries, briefing notes, and updates that help the SVP of Operations move quickly and make better decisions
  • .Support confidential operational and business topics with strong discretion and sound judgment
  • .Identify workflow gaps and process breakdowns, then help design better systems to prevent recurring issues
  • .Use modern tools, including AI where useful, to improve organization, communication, documentation, and execution speed
  • .Occasionally support travel, onsite meetings, or special projects in the US or internationally

.About Yo

  • uYou are exceptionally organized and treat follow-through as a craft
  • .You have experience in a startup, scale-up, or high-growth operating environment
  • .You have worked close enough to operations to understand concepts like suppliers, RFQs, sourcing, fulfillment, logistics, process improvement, and operational workflows
  • .You are comfortable being the person who notices details, tracks commitments, and respectfully pushes people to follow through
  • .You can operate in ambiguity and turn loose ideas, conversations, and priorities into organized plans
  • .You communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English
  • .You are trusted with confidential information and know how to handle sensitive topics with maturity
  • .You have a systems mindset: you can zoom into the details, then zoom out to understand how the full workflow should function
  • .You are comfortable working with senior leaders and adapting to their working style
  • .You are hungry, resourceful, and proud of being excellent at your craft

.Nice-to-Have

  • sExperience in ecommerce, creator commerce, consumer products, marketplaces, logistics, manufacturing, 3PL, or supply chain operations
  • .Experience supporting or partnering closely with an operations executive, founder, GM, or senior leader
  • .Experience coordinating across the US, Latin America, Europe, and Asia
  • .Experience with supplier management, sourcing workflows, procurement, or operational reporting

.Why Join Fourthwall

?You will work directly with a senior operations leader at a fast-growing company powering commerce for some of the biggest creators on the internet. Fourthwall's operations team is lean, global, and high-impact. This is a rare opportunity for someone who loves organization, systems, and execution to become a trusted force multiplier for a scaling supply chain and operations function

If you are operationally fluent, obsessively organized, and energized by helping a fast-moving leader and team execute at a higher level, this is your seat

.Application Proces

  • sInterview with Latin Remote Worker
  • sPractical take-home exercise assessing organization, operations judgment, systems thinking, and communication
  • .Interview with the SVP of Operations
  • .Final interviews with selected members of the Fourthwall operations team

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

7.Garantir que as etapas da esteira avancem somente após o cumprimento dos critérios de aprovação, documentação e aceite estabelecidos.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

11.Acompanhar a aderência entre horas planejadas e horas executadas, identificando variações relevantes e apoiando a análise de suas causas.

12.Apoiar as lideranças na priorização das demandas, considerando capacidade das equipes, prazos, dependências, riscos e impacto financeiro.

13.Monitorar indicadores de performance da esteira, como cumprimento de prazos, variação de horas, tempo médio por etapa, retrabalho, pacotes pendentes e demandas bloqueadas.

14.Propor melhorias nos fluxos, controles, ferramentas e critérios de passagem entre as etapas da esteira de projetos.

15.Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisão por meio de informações confiáveis sobre esforço, custo, prazo, capacidade e andamento dos projetos.

title: Controller de Projetos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Controller de Projetos em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1.Controlar a esteira de entregas dos projetos e demandas, garantindo o correto avanço dos pacotes de tarefas entre as equipes envolvidas.

2.Receber, organizar e validar as informações dos pacotes de tarefas, incluindo escopo, responsáveis, prazos, dependências e critérios de aprovação.

3.Consolidar as estimativas de horas/homem informadas pelas equipes, analisando sua coerência com o escopo e a complexidade da demanda.

4.Apoiar a composição e revisão do orçamento dos projetos, considerando alterações de escopo, esforço, prazos e impactos financeiros.

5.Controlar a aprovação dos pacotes de tarefas e liberar as atividades aprovadas para as próximas equipes da esteira.

6.Acompanhar o andamento dos projetos e pacotes de tarefas, monitorando prazos, responsáveis, pendências, gargalos e desvios.

8.Identificar riscos, atrasos, retrabalhos, inconsistências e bloqueios, acionando as áreas responsáveis para tratativas e ajustes necessários.

9.Manter a rastreabilidade das informações, aprovações, premissas, liberações, entregas e decisões relacionadas aos projetos.

10.Consolidar relatórios gerenciais sobre status das demandas, horas previstas e realizadas, custos estimados, pacotes em andamento, pacotes concluídos e pendências.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Amazon Account Manager (PPC & Marketplace)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Amazon Account Manager (PPC & Marketplace) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Amazon Account Manager (PPC & Marketplace)


We are looking for a high-performance Amazon Account Manager with deep experience scaling CPG brands on Amazon using a full-funnel, data-driven growth system.


This is not a traditional PPC execution role. The focus is on building and optimizing Amazon accounts as growth systems — combining advertising, organic ranking strategy, catalog optimization, and conversion rate improvements to drive category leadership.


The ideal candidate thinks beyond campaign management and operates like an Amazon growth strategist, capable of diagnosing full account performance, identifying leverage points across PPC and organic visibility, and executing structured scaling systems similar to those used by top-performing founder-led Amazon brands.


Key Responsibilities


Amazon Advertising Management

Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

Conduct keyword research, search term analysis, and competitor research.

Monitor and improve key advertising metrics including ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CTR, and conversion rates.

Adjust bids, budgets, targeting strategies, and campaign structures to maximize performance.

Identify growth opportunities and develop strategies to increase sales and profitability.



Marketplace & Account Management

Manage day-to-day Amazon Seller Central operations.

Oversee listing creation, optimization, and maintenance.

Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, and catalog attributes.

Support A+ Content and Brand Store enhancements.

Ensure listings remain accurate, compliant, and fully optimized.


Product Launches & Promotions

Support new product launches and ranking strategies.

Manage promotional activities including coupons, deals, and other visibility initiatives.

Coordinate launch timelines and marketplace readiness.


Reporting & Performance Analysis

Track sales, advertising, and marketplace performance.

Prepare regular reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

Monitor inventory trends and collaborate on inventory planning initiatives.

Analyze account data to identify risks, opportunities, and growth drivers.



Requirements


Must-Have


3+ years of experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

Strong hands-on experience with Amazon PPC and Amazon Advertising.

Experience managing Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns.

Proven ability to improve advertising performance and account growth.

Experience with listing optimization, keyword research, and catalog management.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Near-native English fluency preferred, with the ability to communicate confidently with U.S.-based stakeholders.

Highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently.


Nice-to-Have

Experience with Amazon DSP.

Experience launching new products on Amazon.

Experience with A+ Content and Amazon Brand Stores.

Familiarity with Amazon tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, Sellerboard, Pacvue, Perpetua, Quartile, or similar platforms.

Experience working with CPG, food & beverage, health & wellness, or consumer brands.


Success Metrics

Improved PPC efficiency and profitability.

Growth in Amazon sales, visibility, and market share.

Successful execution of product launches and promotional initiatives.

Accurate, actionable reporting and performance insights.

Well-maintained and highly optimized Amazon listings.



Position Details

Full-time

Remote

Open to candidates across Canada and Latin America

Must be available during U.S. Central Time (CST) business hours

title: Arquiteto(a) / Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (PJ) - REMOTO
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Arquiteto(a) / Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior (PJ) - REMOTO em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Arquiteto(a) / Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior Node.js – Topshare & Creatonomy

  • ATENÇÃO: REQUISITO OBRIGATÓRIOApenas candidatos com experiência comprovada em Node.js devem se candidatar. Candidaturas sem este requisito serão desconsideradas.

    • Sobre a Topshare e o Ecossistema Creatonomy

    A Topshare é uma plataforma de tecnologia que pulsa no coração da creator economy, sendo parte fundamental do grupo Creatonomy.

    Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional sênior para atuar na arquitetura, desenvolvimento, manutenção e aprimoramento contínuo da plataforma Topshare. Além disso, você terá um papel de destaque participando ativamente na criação da plataforma Creatonomy e em outros projetos estratégicos do nosso grupo.

    Nosso foco absoluto é a construção de soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance para impulsionar todo o nosso ecossistema. Operamos em um ambiente de trabalho 100% remoto, onde valorizamos a flexibilidade, a inovação constante e a excelência técnica.

    Missão do Cargo

    Atuar como a nossa principal referência técnica, liderando a concepção e a implementação de soluções de Backend de ponta a ponta.

    Você será o(a) grande responsável por garantir a robustez, a escalabilidade e a alta disponibilidade dos nossos sistemas. Seu desafio diário será traduzir requisitos complexos de negócio em arquiteturas sólidas, elegantes e eficientes, com foco total na stack Node.js.

    Responsabilidades e Escopo de Atividades

    Seu escopo de trabalho abrangerá a totalidade do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software — desde a concepção técnica inicial até a entrega em produção e monitoramento —, com ênfase nas seguintes áreas:

     1. Desenvolvimento de Backend e Arquitetura


    • Construção de ponta: Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs e microsserviços robustos e escaláveis (stack Node.js) para a Topshare e para a plataforma Creatonomy.

    • Gestão de Dados: Modelar, gerir e otimizar dados em bancos MongoDB (NoSQL), garantindo a integridade e a alta disponibilidade de todo o sistema.

    • Evolução Técnica: Contribuir ativamente para a definição e refinamento da arquitetura de microsserviços e a evolução contínua da nossa stack tecnológica.

    • Conteinerização: Utilizar Docker de forma avançada para o empacotamento e execução eficiente dos serviços em ambientes isolados.


    2. Qualidade de Código e Colaboração

    • Boas Práticas: Utilizar Git e seguir rigorosamente as melhores práticas de Git Flow, realizando pull requests e code reviews criteriosos de forma contínua.

    • Resiliência: Implementar testes unitários, de integração e de carga para garantir a confiabilidade e resiliência do sistema.

    • Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe, compartilhando conhecimento, elevando o nível técnico do time e propondo melhorias constantes na arquitetura e nos processos de CI/CD.


    3. Disponibilidade para Incidentes Críticos

    • Comprometimento com a Operação: Como responsável por sistemas de alta disponibilidade, o(a) profissional se compromete a responder e atuar na correção de erros, bugs ou falhas críticas de produção em tempo hábil — inclusive fora do horário comercial — quando a indisponibilidade do sistema impactar diretamente a operação ou a receita da empresa.


    Requisitos Técnicos

    • Experiência sólida e comprovada em desenvolvimento Backend, com foco em sistemas distribuídos e altamente escaláveis.

    • Proficiência avançada em Node.js e no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful/GraphQL.

    • Experiência prática com arquitetura de microsserviços e aplicação de padrões de design (Design Patterns).

    • Experiência sólida com Docker e conceitos modernos de conteinerização.

    • Domínio de bancos de dados NoSQL, com experiência avançada específica em MongoDB.

    • Conhecimento profundo e aplicação de boas práticas de versionamento de código com Git.

    Diferenciais Desejáveis (Nice to have)

    • Experiência com Monorepo ou estratégias de arquitetura de software em aplicações de micros serviços.

    • Experiência prática em serviços AWS, especialmente ECS (Elastic Container Service), ECR (Elastic Container Registry) e Amplify para deploy e orquestração em nuvem.

    • Vivência sólida com monitoramento de aplicações, observabilidade e troubleshooting em ambientes de produção complexos.

     Informações da Vaga

    • Regime de Contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

    • Remuneração: R$ 12.000,00 / mês

    • Local: 100% Remoto

    • Horário de Trabalho: De segunda a sexta-feira, em horário comercial.

    Se você é um(a) Arquiteto(a) / Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior que busca um desafio de ponta a ponta em um ecossistema de alta performance na Creator Economy, queremos conhecer você. Candidate-se!

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Entry Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.


Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.


Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.


Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.


What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.


Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.


Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior / Especialista Databricks
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados Sênior / Especialista Databricks em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior/Especialista com sólida experiência na plataforma Databricks para liderar uma transformação estratégica na nossa fundação de dados.

Seu principal objetivo será extrair a inteligência de negócios hoje \"escondida\" em dashboards e regras DAX, centralizando-a em uma Camada Semântica Corporativa robusta e escalável. Essa estrutura será o alicerce para alimentar nossos Agentes de IA, Copilotos e LLMs , além de garantir governança, linhagem e qualidade de dados de ponta a ponta através do Unity Catalog .


Desafios e Responsabilidades (Frentes de Atuação)Frente 1: Camada Semântica Corporativa & IA Readiness

  • Engenharia Reversa em DAX: Analisar e mapear as regras de negócio e métricas atualmente implementadas em Power BI/DAX.
  • Construção do Repositório Semântico: Estruturar, padronizar e centralizar métricas, dimensões e KPIs corporativos no ecossistema Databricks.
  • Abastecimento de IA: Disponibilizar essa camada semântica e seus contextos de forma otimizada para consumo ágil por LLMs, mecanismos de busca semântica e agentes de IA.
  • Padronização: Definir padrões de arquitetura para a evolução contínua da camada semântica (ex: modelagem dimensional na camada Gold/Semantic).

Frente 2: Catálogo, Descoberta e Governança de Dados

  • Implementação via Unity Catalog: Estruturar o catálogo corporativo unificado para garantir uma experiência centralizada de descoberta de dados (tanto para perfis técnicos quanto de negócio).
  • Centralização do Conhecimento: Migrar e consolidar documentações técnicas e funcionais hoje dispersas (GitLab, Wikis, etc.) para dentro do catálogo de dados.
  • Linhagem e Qualidade: Mapear a linhagem de dados (data lineage) dos ativos críticos e desenhar estratégias/recomendações para monitoramento e qualidade de dados (ex: Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring, Delta Live Tables).

Frente 3: Colaboração e Mentoria

  • Transferência de Conhecimento: Atuar em sinergia com o time interno (Cliente), realizando a passagem de bastão completa das frentes implementadas, padrões definidos e boas práticas adotadas.


Requisitos Técnicos (O que buscamos)

  • Experiência Avançada em Databricks: Domínio da plataforma (Delta Lake, Spark/PySpark, Delta Live Tables e Databricks SQL).
  • Mestre em Unity Catalog: Experiência prática na estruturação de governança, controle de acessos (regras de segurança) e linhagem usando o Unity Catalog.
  • Experiência com Camadas Semânticas: Vivência prática na centralização de métricas de negócio (seja via views homologadas no Databricks, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube ou ferramentas correlatas).
  • Conhecimento em Power BI / DAX: Capacidade de ler, interpretar e traduzir fórmulas DAX complexas para SQL/PySpark.
  • Familiaridade com LLMs/GenAI: Entendimento de como LLMs consomem dados (estruturados e não estruturados), conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e metadados enriquecidos para IA.
  • Práticas de Engenharia de Software: Controle de versão (Git/GitLab), CI/CD aplicado a dados e documentação técnica clara.

Diferenciais (Pontos Extras)

  • Certificações oficiais Databricks (Data Engineer Professional ou Cloud Data Management / Governance).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de qualidade de dados (ex: Great Expectations, Databricks Lakehouse Monitoring).
  • Experiência prévia em projetos de transição de arquitetura Self-Service BI tradicional para Semantic Lakehouse.


Resultados Esperados (O seu legado)

  • Uma Camada Semântica robusta e pronta para servir de contexto a copilotos corporativos.
  • Catálogo Corporativo de Dados funcional, documentado e acessível para usuários técnicos e tomadores de decisão.
  • Redução drástica da dependência de dashboards como \"regras de negócio isoladas\".
  • Uma fundação de dados escalável e governada para as iniciativas de IA da companhia.
  • Time interno capacitado e autônomo para dar continuidade ao trabalho.

Confira esta oportunidade para em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Own a category like it is your own business.


LifeSupplyUSA is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce retailers of household essentials in the US: air filters, HVAC filters, extension cords, and home goods. We sell across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, and Canada with a lean, high-performance remote team, and we are building a sharper, more scalable company with better dashboards, cleaner SOPs, and real ownership.


We are not looking for someone to monitor reports or update listings. We are looking for an operator who turns marketplace data into action and owns the result.


THE ROLE


You will own a defined block of our catalog (starting with extension cords, our largest category) like a P&L. You will know your category and your top competitors cold, watch your listings every day, and make the pricing, inventory, and advertising calls that protect rank and margin.


This is a judgment and ownership role. Not data entry. Not catalog cleanup. Not dashboard watching.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN


Category P&L: in-stock rate, contribution margin, TACOS, and category profit. You run it like an owner.

Daily monitoring of your top SKUs: competitor pricing, deals and lightning deals, stock positions, Buy Box, and listing health.

Pricing decisions within a clear rule set, including our low-stock governor (when a winner runs low, you decide whether to raise price or pull ad spend to protect rank instead of going out of stock).

In-stock discipline on core winners, working with forecasting and sourcing so proven sellers are never starved.

️ Listing quality: titles, images, A+ content, variations, and pack configurations.

♻️ Liquidation calls on end-of-life and slow-moving inventory.

Channel growth: extend your winners onto Walmart, Shopify, and Canada.

Dferenciais

• Experiência em infoprodutos e lançamentos digitais.

• Experiência como Project Owner, Product Owner ou Gestor de Projetos.

title: Gestor de Contas em Operações Comerciais
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gestor de Contas em Operações Comerciais em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a IEXFY

A IEXFY potencializa operações comerciais de empresas de todos os tamanhos e segmentos, combinando conhecimento de negócio e tecnologia de ponta. Somos reconhecidos por falar a língua dos nossos clientes, entender suas dores e entregar soluções personalizadas que realmente geram impacto.


Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos buscando um profissional sênior para atuar na condução de projetos estratégicos de Operações Comerciais e no relacionamento consultivo com nossos clientes.


Procuramos alguém com forte capacidade analítica, excelente comunicação e experiência em ambientes corporativos, capaz de compreender desafios de negócio, estruturar soluções e garantir a evolução contínua dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade.


Esta posição terá atuação próxima aos sócios da empresa e participação ativa na evolução dos processos, métodos e boas práticas da área de CommOps.

Gestão de clientes

  • Garantir a satisfação e o sucesso dos clientes sob sua responsabilidade.

  • Apoiar processos de implantação, evolução e sustentação das soluções;
  • Conduzir validações funcionais e alinhamentos de negócio.

  • Mapear processos e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Participar de iniciativas de discovery e levantamento de requisitos;
  • Apoiar a definição de regras de negócio e indicadores;
  • Atuar como parceiro consultivo dos clientes na evolução de suas operações comerciais.


Governança e melhoria contínua

  • Garantir documentação adequada dos projetos;
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos processos internos da IEXFY;
  • Apoiar a definição e acompanhamento de indicadores da operação;
  • Disseminar boas práticas e conhecimento dentro da equipe.


Requisitos


Obrigatórios

  • Experiência em áreas como Commercial, Sales and Revenue Operations, Inteligência ou Planejamento Comercial, Inteligência de Vendas e Produtividade ou Efetividade de Vendas
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos corporativos;
  • Experiência em relacionamento consultivo com clientes;
  • Vivência em implantação ou sustentação de soluções de tecnologia;
  • Capacidade de conduzir reuniões executivas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e organização;
  • Perfil proativo, autônomo e orientado a resultados.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em consultorias de gestão ou tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos e processos;
  • Experiência com Power BI, CRM ou plataformas corporativas;

Competências que valorizamos

  • Senso de dono;

title: Senior Frontend (Angular) Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Frontend (Angular) Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

XILO , a fast-growing Vertical AI company recently backed by a Series A financing round, is seeking a highly experienced and driven Senior Frontend Engineer to elevate our Angular codebase, improve modularity, and mentor junior engineers in writing clean, maintainable front-end code.

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

You’ll be at the heart of shaping the user experience for thousands of insurance professionals, wrapping powerful AI-driven automation in an intuitive, efficient, and beautiful interface.

This isn’t just another frontend job. Insurance agents spend hours wrestling with outdated, clunky systems -your work will change that. We’ve seen first-hand how much frustration our automation removes, and with your help, we’ll take it even further – creating tools that don’t just work, but feel seamless, fast, and a joy to use.

We’re building with modern frontend technologies, including Angular , to ensure high performance, efficiency, and scalability. If you’re an expert in Angular’s latest features , you’ll have a unique opportunity to push the boundaries of frontend performance and UX in a data-heavy, AI-powered platform.


You’ll have the opportunity to work on:

  • Modern UI & UX for AI-Driven Automation – Designing interfaces that make complex workflows feel effortless
  • Agent-Focused Productivity Tools – Crafting dashboards and interactive tools that help agencies work faster and smarter
  • Seamless Platform Experience – Maintaining and evolving our design system to ensure a consistent, polished experience across the platform
  • AI-Powered Browser Extensions – Building extensions that bring AI Agents to life beyond APIs, automating workflows directly on carrier portals and legacy systems that don’t support direct integrations
  • Advanced PDF Processing & Rendering – Creating dynamic, interactive document management tools that handle complex insurance forms and policies seamlessly


Qualifications

  • 7+ years of frontend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Extensive experience with Angular (19+), including migrating projects to newer versions.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos to manage and scale frontend applications efficiently.
  • Optimizing build processes to improve application performance and loading times.
  • Proficient in REST API integration, including security and authentication strategies.
  • Bonus: Hands-on experience developing browser extensions, extending automation beyond traditional web applications.
  • Bonus: Experience with WebSockets for real-time data updates and event-driven UI interactions.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with backend technologies like Node.js and Nest.js.


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.


Why join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / React)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / React) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Remote Contract Developer at Honor Tech LLC

Honor Tech LLC is a growing company specializing in custom software development for public sector initiatives and private companies alike. We have recently acquired new contracts that require talented developers to join our team quickly. 

Why Join Honor Tech?

This remote-friendly contract position offers significant flexibility and an opportunity to contribute to impactful projects with a dedicated, positive team. As a young, agile company, we are focused on growth, and as we expand, there may be opportunities to move top performers into salaried roles and/or leadership positions.

About You

We’re looking for a self-sufficient, experienced full-stack software developer who can hit the ground running without training beyond their existing skills. You should be comfortable working independently while also collaborating with teammates as needed. You’re adaptable, quick to solve problems, and thrive in a fast-paced, Agile/Scrum environment. While we encourage continued learning, this position is not a training role: we need someone who can contribute immediately and deliver results from day one. Times are changing and Honor Tech is aware and immersed in this, so we also expect that you will come to the table with a solid understanding of how to use the latest AI tooling to enhance your development and have embraced (as opposed to resisted) this massive shift in the tech industry. A combination of the right experience and the right adaptation of new skills will make the perfect candidate for this role.

Responsibilities
  • Independently design, develop, and maintain web applications using ReactJS, TypeScript, and .NET (C#).
  • Build and integrate modern APIs with validation, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
  • Design and optimize database schemas and SQL queries for performance and scalability in SQL Server, MariaDB, and MySQL.
  • Configure and manage AWS infrastructure (EC2, IAM, VPNs, security groups) and set up monitoring tools like CloudWatch.
  • Integrate Mail Servers (SMTP) and build scalable email solutions with tracking and retry capabilities.
  • Implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and authentication systems to secure APIs and web applications.
  • Ensure scalability and fault tolerance with multi-threading, parallel programming, and queuing systems.
  • Perform unit testing, end-to-end testing, and stress testing to validate system performance and reliability.
  • Write clear, customer-facing technical documentation and contribute to development standards and best practices.
  • Use AI-assisted coding tools where appropriate, validating all AI-generated code for correctness and performance.
Required Skills and Experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack web development.
  • Proficiency in ReactJS and TypeScript for frontend development.
  • Proficiency in .NET (C#) for backend API and service development.
  • Strong SQL skills and database experience with SQL Server, MariaDB, or MySQL.
  • Experience with AWS infrastructure, including EC2, IAM roles, security groups, and CloudWatch monitoring.
  • Hands-on experience with Mail Servers and SMTP Integration for email workflows and tracking.
  • Expertise in API Development and Integration, including RESTful and SOAP protocols, rate-limiting, and error handling.
  • Experience implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and authentication mechanisms.
  • Ability to build scalable, fault-tolerant systems for high-volume transactions.
  • Proven ability to work independently and start contributing immediately without extensive onboarding or training.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English. You must be able to comfortably participate in live, spontaneous technical discussions and write clear documentation independently, without the use of translation software or real-time translation tools.  
Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Experience with Amplify and Cognito for authentication and user management.
  • Experience with Microsoft Identity.
  • Familiarity with Twilio and SendGrid integrations.
  • Knowledge of DevExpress and for UI components.
  • Experience with Dapper and EFCore for database optimization.
  • Skills in parallel programming, dependency injection, and scalability-focused development.
  • Prior use of AI-assisted coding tools with proper validation techniques.

Job Type: Full-time Contract (40 hours/week)

Pay: Competitive Hourly Rate (TBD based on experience, paid in USD)

Compensation & Compliance: Independent Contractor Agreement. Paid via W-9 (US-based) or W-8BEN/International Contractor terms (Non-US).

Schedule: Flexible 8-hour days, 5 days per week. Requires core hours overlap for standing/recurring team meetings.

Work Location: Remote


If you’re ready to jump in and deliver results immediately as part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team, we’d love to hear from you! Contact us today to learn more about how you can contribute to Honor Tech LLC's mission.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Accounting Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients


About U S

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.


The Accounting Manager owns all accounting outcomes for assigned clients, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to TGG Way standards. They oversee Staff Accountant transactional work, uphold controls and processes, and guide team execution to deliver reliable financial statements to the Controller.


Responsibilities

Weekly

•Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collection issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Complete the full client Technical QA checklist through the Month-End Workbook

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to the Controller for review and payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the StaffAccountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in the financial package

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff Accountant

• Understand the purpose of existing KPIs and roll them forward each month

• Confirm financial accuracy across statements, KPIs, executive summaries, charts, graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

• Complete 941 reconciliations

• Prepare and submit sales tax returns with Controller approval

Annually

• Coordinate, review, and submit 1099s annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

• Review the new client’s current process and procedural documents

• Recommend and document new processes for the Controller to sign off on

• Create initial reports, including Cash Flow Forecast, AP Tracker, Month-End Workbook, and Financial Package

• Delegate updates to the Staff Accountant


Requirements

4+ years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S.GAAP

Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations

Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)

Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)

Fluent English (written and spoken)

Accounting or Finance degree

Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment

Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.

Can work US Timezone schedules 9 am to 5 pm EST


Benefits

Ful ly remote role with some flexibility included

Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes

Access to TGG University and learning resources

Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm

PTO after the onboarding period (most local holidays included)


Notes:

This position is to join us as an Independent Contractor

Payment after 3 months will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

Competitive Salary + Benefits

Full-Time


We're partnering with an established technology company operating at the intersection of content, data, and financial information services.

They're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to play a key role in building and scaling API-driven products that power data distribution, licensing, and content delivery at scale.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll take ownership of designing, building, and scaling backend services that underpin critical API products.

You'll work closely with product, engineering, and leadership teams to shape technical strategy, architect scalable systems, and deliver high-quality software that directly impacts customers.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, has strong architectural instincts, and wants to contribute beyond just writing code.

✅ Building and scaling API-first products and backend platforms

✅ Designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance distributed systems

✅ Taking ownership of the full software development lifecycle

✅ Working closely with stakeholders to define requirements and product enhancements

✅ Contributing to architecture decisions and long-term technical strategy

✅ Improving development processes, tooling, and engineering best practices

✅ Participating in technical planning and cross-functional collaboration

✅ Mentoring junior engineers and helping grow the engineering team

✅ Supporting recruitment and technical hiring initiatives

Essential Experience

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong commercial experience with Go (Golang)
  • Experience building and maintaining large-scale backend applications
  • Strong understanding of software design principles and design patterns
  • Experience designing and consuming APIs
  • Kubernetes and containerized application experience
  • Experience working within Agile development environments
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills


You'll Thrive Here If You

✔ Enjoy building products used by thousands of customers

✔ Like solving challenging technical and architectural problems

✔ Are curious about new technologies and engineering best practices

✔ Want to influence both product and technical direction

✔ Have an interest in financial markets, media, content, or data-driven products

✔ Love creating software that customers genuinely value


Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Equivalent practical experience is equally valued—we're just as interested in exceptional engineers who have built great software and can demonstrate their impact.

Why join XILO?

  • .Experience supporting or partnering closely with an operations executive, founder, GM, or senior leader
  • .Experience coordinating across the US, Latin America, Europe, and Asia
  • .Experience with supplier management, sourcing workflows, procurement, or operational reporting

.Why Join Fourthwall

?You will work directly with a senior operations leader at a fast-growing company powering commerce for some of the biggest creators on the internet. Fourthwall's operations team is lean, global, and high-impact. This is a rare opportunity for someone who loves organization, systems, and execution to become a trusted force multiplier for a scaling supply chain and operations function

title: Head of Growth
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Head of Growth em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process and deliver tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

We’re free for brands and monetize on the agency side. Customers include Shopify, Coca-Cola, Columbia Records, Burt’s Bees, Roc Nation, Magic Spoon, Sony Music, and Estée Lauder, plus a long list of venture-backed and mid-market brands. We also operate Case Studied, a 40,000+ subscriber marketing newsletter that’s become one of the most-read publications in B2B marketing.


About the Role

This is an individual contributor role. It is not a management role. You will not be hiring, leading, or coaching a team. You will be running experiments, lots of them, across paid media, SEO, and product surfaces, and you will be doing the work yourself.


The title says Head of Growth, but the work is hands-on. You’ll be in the ads manager every day. You’ll be writing your own copy, generating your own creative, building your own landing page tests, and shipping your own programmatic SEO templates. If you want to spend your week in dashboards, spinning up tests, and arguing with the data, this is the right role. If you want to delegate any of that, it isn’t.


The right person treats growth as a lab. You have a testing instinct that’s borderline obsessive. You wake up wondering whether you can squeeze 15% more efficiency out of a LinkedIn audience. Whether a programmatic SEO template can be expanded to 5,000 more pages. Whether a free tool converts better as a calculator or a benchmark. You don’t wait for permission to test. You’d rather ship a rough experiment this week than wait three weeks for a clean one.


You’ll report directly to the CEO. You’ll set the growth roadmap, prioritize the test backlog, and allocate the budget. The work is yours to run.


What You’ll Do

Paid Media

• Run paid media yourself across LinkedIn, Google, and Meta. Daily optimization, audience and creative testing, budget shifts, the actual button-clicking. You are the person in the platform, not the person reviewing someone else’s screenshots.

• Design and run a structured testing program. We expect multiple live experiments at any given time across audiences, creative, landing pages, and bidding.

• Maintain clean test design. Isolated variables, defined sample sizes, written hypotheses, and post-mortems with real takeaways.

• Pilot new paid channels (Reddit, X, podcast sponsorships, partner ads) when signal suggests they’re worth a test.


Ad Creative

• Concept and produce ad creative yourself using AI tools. You should be the person making the creative, not the person briefing someone to make it.

• Brief external designers, UGC creators, and motion partners when production volume goes beyond what you can ship solo.

• Keep the creative pipeline healthy. Every underperforming slot gets refreshed quickly.

• Turn winning angles into testable variations across channels.


SEO and Programmatic SEO

• Own the SEO roadmap for vendry.io and Case Studied.

• Build programmatic SEO at scale. Page templates, structured data inputs, internal linking, sitemap architecture, and indexation strategy.

• Run scalable SEO experiments across page structure, content depth, intent matching, and CTAs.

• Coordinate with engineering on technical implementation and Core Web Vitals.


Product-Led Experiments

• Work with engineering to ship lead magnets, free tools, viral mechanics, and shareable assets.

• Identify the product surfaces where small changes move the funnel (onboarding, results pages, share flows) and design experiments against them.

• Treat product and marketing as one funnel. Close the loop between channel performance and on-site experience.


Measurement

• Build and maintain the growth dashboard yourself. Spend, MQLs, pipeline, CAC, payback, channel-level efficiency.

• Communicate weekly results in plain language. What worked, what didn’t, what’s next.

• Make budget decisions based on data, not recency or intuition.


Qualifications

Required

• 5+ years in growth, performance marketing, or demand generation as a hands-on operator.

• Demonstrated B2B experience is mandatory. This role will not work for someone whose track record is purely DTC or consumer. You need to understand B2B funnel dynamics: long sales cycles, MQL-to-pipeline conversion, account-level intent, and how creative and channel decisions ripple through a slow funnel.

• Direct, hands-on experience running LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and Meta at meaningful spend.

• AI-native creative production. You should be able to ship an ad concept yourself in a few hours using current tools (Midjourney, Runway, Claude or ChatGPT for copy, similar).

• Programmatic SEO experience. We want to see a project you shipped, not just familiarity with the concept.

• A genuine love for experimentation. This is the core requirement of the role. You should be the kind of person who runs personal experiments on the side, who reads test results for fun, who has strong opinions about test design and sample sizes. If you don’t actively enjoy this, the role won’t click.

• A real testing track record. Be ready to walk through experiments you designed, ran, and learned from in detail. Hypothesis, design, result, takeaway.

• Strong analytical instincts. Spreadsheets, dashboards, and attribution tools (GA4, HubSpot, Meta and LinkedIn reporting) should be second nature.

• Strong growth mindset and fast learning curve. The channels we win on a year from now may not be the ones we win on today. You should be wired to pick up new platforms quickly and be intellectually honest when a channel stops working.


Preferred

• Background in a B2B marketplace, agency, or SaaS company that grew primarily through paid acquisition.

• Familiarity with HubSpot, Monday.com, Make or n8n, and similar GTM tooling.

• Newsletter or media growth experience.

• Past product-led growth work alongside engineering.

• Ownership of a content or SEO program that produced meaningful inbound.


Not a fit if

• You want to manage people. There is no team here, and we’re not building one for this role.

• You’re used to setting strategy and handing it off. Strategy here is whatever you ship and ship next.

• You need a clean, slow testing environment. Vendry moves fast and tests cheap.


Why Join Vendry

This role is for someone who wants to operate, not manage. You’ll work directly with the CEO, set your own roadmap, run your own budget, and see the impact of your work in pipeline every week.


The marketing engine works already. Paid social drives MQLs. Case Studied reaches 40,000+ marketing decision-makers. We close deals with brand-name client logos every month. We need one person who can systematize what’s working and run experiments hard enough to find the next thing.


We’re a small, fast, collaborative team. We value quality work, sharp judgment, and direct communication.

title: Amazon Account Manager (PPC & Marketplace)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Amazon Account Manager (PPC & Marketplace) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Amazon Account Manager (PPC & Marketplace)


We are looking for a high-performance Amazon Account Manager with deep experience scaling CPG brands on Amazon using a full-funnel, data-driven growth system.


This is not a traditional PPC execution role. The focus is on building and optimizing Amazon accounts as growth systems — combining advertising, organic ranking strategy, catalog optimization, and conversion rate improvements to drive category leadership.


The ideal candidate thinks beyond campaign management and operates like an Amazon growth strategist, capable of diagnosing full account performance, identifying leverage points across PPC and organic visibility, and executing structured scaling systems similar to those used by top-performing founder-led Amazon brands.


Key Responsibilities


Amazon Advertising Management

Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display.

Conduct keyword research, search term analysis, and competitor research.

Monitor and improve key advertising metrics including ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CTR, and conversion rates.

Adjust bids, budgets, targeting strategies, and campaign structures to maximize performance.

Identify growth opportunities and develop strategies to increase sales and profitability.



Marketplace & Account Management

Manage day-to-day Amazon Seller Central operations.

Oversee listing creation, optimization, and maintenance.

Optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, and catalog attributes.

Support A+ Content and Brand Store enhancements.

Ensure listings remain accurate, compliant, and fully optimized.


Product Launches & Promotions

Support new product launches and ranking strategies.

Manage promotional activities including coupons, deals, and other visibility initiatives.

Coordinate launch timelines and marketplace readiness.


Reporting & Performance Analysis

Track sales, advertising, and marketplace performance.

Prepare regular reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

Monitor inventory trends and collaborate on inventory planning initiatives.

Analyze account data to identify risks, opportunities, and growth drivers.



Requirements


Must-Have


3+ years of experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

Strong hands-on experience with Amazon PPC and Amazon Advertising.

Experience managing Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns.

Proven ability to improve advertising performance and account growth.

Experience with listing optimization, keyword research, and catalog management.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions.

Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Near-native English fluency preferred, with the ability to communicate confidently with U.S.-based stakeholders.

Highly organized, proactive, and able to work independently.


Nice-to-Have

Experience with Amazon DSP.

Experience launching new products on Amazon.

Experience with A+ Content and Amazon Brand Stores.

Familiarity with Amazon tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Data Dive, Sellerboard, Pacvue, Perpetua, Quartile, or similar platforms.

Experience working with CPG, food & beverage, health & wellness, or consumer brands.


Success Metrics

Improved PPC efficiency and profitability.

Growth in Amazon sales, visibility, and market share.

Successful execution of product launches and promotional initiatives.

Accurate, actionable reporting and performance insights.

Well-maintained and highly optimized Amazon listings.



Position Details

Full-time

Remote

Open to candidates across Canada and Latin America

Must be available during U.S. Central Time (CST) business hours

Work Remotely, Part-time, Internship


We want “Campus Connectors”—social, trend-aware, creative students who can link us with campus creators, produce viral content, and run fun events to make our brand pop on campus.


What You’ll Do:

● Get to know Your Peers: Track the real needs and content preferences of students from different backgrounds (like international students) continuously.

● Create Engaging Content Together: Participate in planning and producing social media content, and discover and collaborate with rising campus stars.

● Plan and Launch Fun Events: Help organize and support promotional events or collaborations that elevate brand activity and impact on campus.



We Hope You Are:

● A campus socializer: You're active in clubs and events, with a lot of friends online and offline, making you a key influencer.

● Trendy Visual Content Creator: You love snapping photos, editing videos, and are passionate about visual trends in fashion, beauty, and more.

● Operations Savvy: You have knowledge of managing social media and engaging with student behaviors and cultural trends.



Bonus Points If You Have:

● Relevant studies in fields like media, fashion, marketing, or sociology.

● Have content creation experience: run your own social account or create content regularly.

● Understand youth culture in regions like Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, Europe, or the US.

● Leadership experience in clubs or project organization on campus.



What You’ll Get

Co-creation & Growth

● Early access to product features and training sessions

● Workshops on social media, product, or design


Rewards & Credit System

We’ll regularly post tasks with different credit values. Pick what interests you, complete tasks to earn credits and base pay. With an exceptional peformance, you will earn bonus creditws!

Redeem credits for:

● Annual Meitu VIP membership

● “Meitu Elite Campus Ambassador” Certificate + internship reference

● Meitu Special Deisgn

● Exclusive chats with Meitu experts/executive leadership

● Summer Internship Offer

● Greenlight for graduate hires interview (skip some interview rounds and get priority hiring after graduation)


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.


Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.


At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Engagement Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engagement Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Engagement Manager


Drive customer success. Lead digital transformation. Deliver meaningful outcomes.

At Radsoft, we help organizations accelerate their digital transformation through innovative software solutions, low-code platforms, and modern engineering practices.


With over two decades of experience delivering business-critical solutions across multiple industries, we combine deep technical expertise with a people-first culture that empowers teams to innovate, collaborate, and create real business impact.


We're looking for an Engagement Manager who thrives at the intersection of business, technology, and customer success. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working directly with clients, understanding business challenges, translating requirements into actionable solutions, and leading multidisciplinary teams to successful project delivery.


If you're passionate about building strong customer relationships, facilitating collaboration, and delivering value through Agile software development, we'd love to hear from you.


Your mission

As an Engagement Manager, you'll be responsible for driving successful project outcomes while serving as the primary bridge between customers and delivery teams.


You'll own stakeholder engagement, requirements management, backlog prioritization, Agile delivery processes, and overall project success.


What you'll do

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers throughout the project lifecycle.
